- If this is a **security vulnerability**, please do **not disclose it publicly** before the issue is resolved.  
- We follow **responsible disclosure** and will work with you to address the issue promptly.  
- You can also **report privately** via email at: **[security@example.com](mailto:security@example.com)** (Replace with actual contact email).
